title: MålBær – Sensors for autonomous precision harvesting of strawberries - sintef.no
summary: SAGA Robotics and Noronn have previously developed a strawberry-picking robot. This project will introduce a sensor suite for in-situ quality assessment of strawberries on the bush. The system will improve quality, volume, and forecasting, and will contribute to reduction of food waste throughout the value chain.
